'''Ast Kikorie''', also called "'''Down Below'''," was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Ast Kikorie Station|astrocartographic research outpost]] with a ring of [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] telescopes connected to [[Kikorie City]] by a [[Skyhook/Legends|skyhook]]. The planet was abandoned by the Republic at the onset of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].

==History==
The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was located in the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The prefix "Ast" was a remnant of the planet's history as an [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Ast Kikorie Station|astrocartographic research outpost]], originally established to map the areas of [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] closed to the Moddell sector. The Republic constructed a ring of [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] telescopes around Ast Kikorie that connected to [[Kikorie City]] by a [[Skyhook/Legends|skyhook]], but eventually abandoned them when the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] broke out in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. Over time, the telescopes were abandoned but not forgotten. During the early years of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], [[astrocartographer]]s found records of Ast Kikories' telescopes, and made the dangerous journey to the Moddell sector in order to use "free" telescope time. The natives of the planet called it "Down Below," a reference to the ring of telescopes and other docking platforms that filled Ast Kikorie's skies.
